{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove any non-numeric characters (none visible in unique values, but just in case)
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(r'[^0-9.]', '', regex=True)

# Convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
print(df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum(), 'rows with invalid revenue')

# Now compute conversion rate by segment
df_grouped = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)

# Sort descending to find the highest conversion rate
df_grouped_sorted = df_grouped.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Print the result
df_grouped_sorted"}
